product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy, now SalesMail, provides personalized video messaging and AI-powered tour coaching to help sales and marketing teams in senior living, home care, and other relationship-driven industries build trust and convert prospects.
product_one_liner.notes: HeartLegacy unified its company and product branding under SalesMail; current SalesMail sources refer to the same company.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL presents a demo/contact form rather than plans or prices; the HeartLegacy site is now a rebrand landing page.

employee_band.notes: The HeartLegacy profile reports 17 employees as of 2026-08-31; this band reflects that dated count.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains sales, marketing, industry advice, customer stories, and product announcements, not a qualifying engineering publication.

public_docs.notes: Public Help Center with multiple product-support articles and categories.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist; neither is a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude API; Amazon Web Services Amazon Transcribe
model_provider.notes: The Sidekick mobile-app privacy policy, last modified 2026-10-01, names Amazon Transcribe for speech-to-text and Claude API for summaries, coaching, scores, and follow-up drafts.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 certification is explicitly in progress, not completed. The privacy policy has a GDPR statement but does not claim certification. No completed certification among the requested five is claimed on these pages.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile explicitly says the company is unfunded and has not raised any funding rounds; no round date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding rounds are reported in the profile updated 2026-09-17; no qualifying round was identified for 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed openings are Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist, not SDR, BDR, or Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail launched Sidekick, an AI coaching and tour-intelligence platform for senior living, on 2026-09-16, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Corey DeGeorge was announced as the new COO on 2025-12-22. This was an internal appointment after more than five years with the company, not an external hire or a departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Demand Generation Specialist posting explicitly describes these outbound tools/workflows. Zoho CRM is described as supporting future integrations and tooling evolution; it is not evidence of a completed deployment. Customer-facing CRM integrations are not treated as proof of internal use.
